seo.title: About — Invenio Homes
seo.description: Innovators, pioneers, consummate professionals. The story, standards and people behind Invenio Homes — a private collection of villas in Ibiza, Formentera, Mykonos and Bali.

hero.title: Why are we *best of class*?
hero.lede: With a focus on building strong and long-lasting relationships, we help industry professionals and best-of-class villa owners grow and improve their businesses.

story.title: Born from a passion for property, and a frustration with how it was being represented.
paragraphs: Invenio Homes was founded by consummate professionals with decades of experience in the real estate rental market. We pride ourselves on a dedication to constantly growing and evolving — to offer the very best, bespoke service in our field.

Our standards are unwaveringly high. We have high expectations of our team, and we consistently strive to improve our service to owners and agents alike. We take great care to form honest relationships with our partners, based on trust, integrity and the very highest level of care.

The platform came later, and from the same instinct: the people doing the work deserved better tools. Today it is the quiet engine behind the portfolio — availability, rates, contracts and reporting, in one place.
story.imageAlt: A turquoise cove in the Mediterranean
story.pullquote: We take great care to form honest relationships with our partners, based on trust, integrity and the very highest level of care.

items.title: Technology
items.body: Our custom-built search tool and dashboard has been developed alongside market leaders who understand what is needed to make a company a success — fast results at the most competitive price.

items.title: Villas
items.body: Every villa is vetted to meet our best-of-class standard and constantly monitored so that quality is never compromised, across the complete portfolio.

items.title: Account managers
items.body: Each account manager is responsible for a select number of properties and owners — in-depth knowledge, with access to the hundreds of other houses on the dashboard.

items.title: Partners
items.body: Every destination is supported with local knowledge and service. Your clients are in safe hands — and so are you.
